description: Point a dedicated, otherwise unused hostname at Bavimail for open and click tracking on emails sent through Bavimail (the open pixel and the rewritten links are served under this hostname), and publish a one-time ownership verification record for that hostname.
variableDescription: trackingTarget is the CNAME target label issued by the Bavimail backend for this tracking hostname. verificationToken is a fresh opaque ownership token issued by the Bavimail backend and bound to the account, the hostname and this setup attempt; it is never a private key or credential. The tracking hostname itself is supplied through the standard Domain Connect domain and host parameters.
